definitionEn: To grant an official title, right, or advantage, or to hold a formal discussion to exchange views.
meaningVi: trao tặng, mang lại, hội ý
existingExample: Bilingual upbringing appears to confer measurable cognitive advantages in executive control and attention switching.

definitionEn: A striking difference between two or more things when they are examined or compared side by side.
meaningVi: sự tương phản, sự đối lập
existingExample: The report highlights a stark contrast between metropolitan employment growth and rural economic stagnation.

definitionEn: A series of events, processes, or stages that recur regularly in the same sequential order.
meaningVi: chu kỳ, vòng tuần hoàn
existingExample: Targeted microfinance initiatives can help low-income households break the intergenerational cycle of poverty.

definitionEn: A formal, structured, or public discussion in which opposing arguments on an issue are examined.
meaningVi: cuộc tranh luận, sự thảo luận chuyên sâu
existingExample: The deployment of generative artificial intelligence in classrooms has sparked intense ethical debate among educators.

definitionEn: A distinct aspect, feature, or measurable extent of a problem, concept, or physical object.
meaningVi: khía cạnh, chiều kích, kích thước
existingExample: Any comprehensive assessment of urban livability must consider its cultural dimension alongside economic indicators.

definitionEn: Relating to a country's internal affairs and economy, or pertaining to the home and family life.
meaningVi: trong nước, nội địa, thuộc gia đình
existingExample: Strengthening domestic consumer demand can cushion an economy against sudden downturns in international trade.

definitionEn: To become gradually visible, known, or prominent after being concealed or undeveloped.
meaningVi: nổi lên, xuất hiện, lộ rõ
existingExample: Clear consensus began to emerge among delegates regarding the urgency of phasing out coal-fired power plants.

definitionEn: A mistake, inaccuracy, or deviation from correctness in calculation, judgement, or procedure.
meaningVi: sai sót, lỗi, sai số
existingExample: Automated cross-checking software substantially reduces the incidence of human error in hospital prescription records.

definitionEn: Relating to a population group that shares common cultural traditions, ancestry, language, or heritage.
meaningVi: thuộc dân tộc, sắc tộc
existingExample: Inclusive language policies help preserve the heritage of ethnic minority communities within multicultural states.

definitionEn: A clearly defined objective or desired result toward which sustained effort is directed.
meaningVi: mục tiêu, đích đến
existingExample: Achieving universal primary education remains a foundational goal of international development agencies.

definitionEn: A sum of money awarded by a government, foundation, or institution to support a specific purpose.
meaningVi: khoản tài trợ, trợ cấp không hoàn lại
existingExample: The biomedical research team secured a five-year federal grant to investigate antibiotic resistance mechanisms.

definitionEn: To put a plan, policy, regulation, or system into practical effect.
meaningVi: triển khai, thực thi, áp dụng
existingExample: Municipalities must implement strict zoning regulations to curb unregulated urban sprawl onto fertile farmland.

definitionEn: To show that someone or something is involved in or causally linked to a problem, process, or wrongdoing.
meaningVi: cho thấy có liên quan, lôi kéo vào, quy trách nhiệm
existingExample: Recent toxicological analyses implicate synthetic agricultural pesticides in the sharp decline of native bee colonies.

definitionEn: To force an obligation, tax, restriction, or standard to be accepted or complied with.
meaningVi: áp đặt, ban hành bắt buộc, gây gánh nặng
existingExample: Several European capitals now impose congestion charges on private vehicles entering historic city centres.

definitionEn: To combine separate components, systems, or groups smoothly into a unified whole.
meaningVi: tích hợp, hội nhập, kết hợp hài hòa
existingExample: Secondary schools are increasingly seeking ways to integrate digital literacy across humanities and science subjects.

definitionEn: Existing, occurring, or operating within the boundaries of an organization, body, or country.
meaningVi: bên trong, nội bộ, nội tại
existingExample: An independent internal audit uncovered procedural weaknesses in how departmental procurement contracts were approved.

definitionEn: To examine a phenomenon, problem, or allegation systematically in order to uncover facts or causes.
meaningVi: điều tra, nghiên cứu khảo sát kỹ lưỡng
existingExample: The interdisciplinary team was commissioned to investigate the socio-ecological impacts of deep-sea mineral extraction.

definitionEn: A paid position of regular employment or a specific role performed within an economy or organization.
meaningVi: công việc, việc làm, chức vụ
existingExample: Transitioning toward clean manufacturing is expected to generate substantial long-term job creation across regional towns.

definitionEn: To assign a descriptive name, category, or classification to a person, product, or phenomenon.
meaningVi: gắn nhãn, phân loại, định danh
existingExample: Consumer advocacy groups urge regulators to label ultra-processed foods with clear front-of-pack nutritional warnings.

definitionEn: A natural, institutional, or mechanical process by which a specific result or function is produced.
meaningVi: cơ chế, cơ cấu vận hành
existingExample: Transparent pricing serves as an essential market mechanism for encouraging industries to curb greenhouse gas emissions.

definitionEn: Easily perceived, recognized, or understood without the need for elaborate proof.
meaningVi: hiển nhiên, rõ rệt, dễ nhận thấy
existingExample: While the economic benefits of tourism are obvious, its strain on fragile local ecosystems is often overlooked.

definitionEn: To reside in, fill a space or period of time, or hold an official position or status.
meaningVi: chiếm giữ, cư trú, nắm giữ (vị trí)
existingExample: Women still occupy a disproportionately small share of executive board seats in major financial institutions.

definitionEn: One of several possible choices, courses of action, or alternatives available in a given situation.
meaningVi: sự lựa chọn, phương án
existingExample: Expanding commuter rail corridors represents a more sustainable option than repeatedly widening urban motorways.

definitionEn: The total amount of goods, energy, work, or information produced by a person, machine, or economy.
meaningVi: sản lượng, đầu ra, hiệu suất sản xuất
existingExample: Modernizing agricultural supply chains can raise rural economic output while minimizing post-harvest food waste.

definitionEn: Taking every aspect into account; comprehensive, general, or total in scope.
meaningVi: tổng thể, toàn diện, nhìn chung
existingExample: Despite localized fluctuations, the overall trend in global adult literacy rates has remained strongly upward.

definitionEn: Occurring at the same time, following a similar course, or sharing closely analogous characteristics.
meaningVi: song song, tương đồng
existingExample: Historians have noted parallel developments in urban sanitation across nineteenth-century London and Paris.

definitionEn: A measurable factor, boundary, or fixed criterion that defines the scope or operation of a system.
meaningVi: thông số, tham số, giới hạn quy định
existingExample: Water salinity is a critical environmental parameter that determines which species can survive in estuarine habitats.

definitionEn: A distinct period or recognizable stage within a longer process of development or change.
meaningVi: giai đoạn, thời kỳ
existingExample: The vaccine candidate entered its final clinical testing phase following promising safety results in earlier cohorts.

definitionEn: To forecast or estimate a future event, trend, or outcome using data, models, or reasoning.
meaningVi: dự đoán, dự báo
existingExample: High-resolution meteorological models allow forecasters to predict extreme coastal storms with increasing lead times.

definitionEn: First in order of importance, rank, or causal influence.
meaningVi: chính, chủ yếu, hàng đầu
existingExample: Habitat fragmentation remains the principal driver of biodiversity loss across temperate woodland ecosystems.

definitionEn: Existing, occurring, or required earlier in time or order of importance.
meaningVi: trước đó, có trước
existingExample: Candidates with prior experience in quantitative data analysis typically adapt faster to postgraduate research.

definitionEn: Relating to a specialized occupation requiring formal qualifications, ethical standards, and advanced competence.
meaningVi: chuyên nghiệp, thuộc nghề nghiệp chuyên môn
existingExample: Ongoing professional development is essential for teachers to keep pace with evolving pedagogical research.

definitionEn: A planned, collaborative enterprise or research initiative designed to achieve a defined objective within a timeframe.
meaningVi: dự án, công trình nghiên cứu
existingExample: The transnational railway project is expected to cut freight transit times across central Europe by nearly half.

definitionEn: To actively encourage, support, or advance the growth, adoption, or success of something.
meaningVi: thúc đẩy, khuyến khích, quảng bá
existingExample: Public subsidies for electric buses are intended to promote low-emission commuting in densely populated cities.

definitionEn: To find a satisfactory solution to a conflict, difficulty, or complex analytical problem.
meaningVi: giải quyết, tháo gỡ, quyết tâm
existingExample: Multilateral diplomacy remains the most durable way to resolve transboundary disputes over shared river basins.

definitionEn: To continue to keep, possess, hold, or preserve something over time.
meaningVi: giữ lại, duy trì, bảo tồn
existingExample: Healthy wetland soils retain vast quantities of atmospheric carbon and mitigate seasonal downstream flooding.

definitionEn: A number of related events, experiments, or publications occurring or issued in succession.
meaningVi: chuỗi, loạt, dãy liên tiếp
existingExample: The institute conducted a series of controlled laboratory trials to evaluate the durability of biodegradable polymers.

definitionEn: A single numerical fact, figure, or quantitative measure derived from systematic data collection.
meaningVi: số liệu thống kê, chỉ số thống kê
existingExample: Youth unemployment remains a sobering economic statistic despite robust aggregate growth in the technology sector.

definitionEn: The relative social, legal, or professional standing of someone, or the current condition of a process.
meaningVi: tình trạng, địa vị, vị thế
existingExample: Conservation agencies regularly reassess the endangered status of migratory birds affected by wetland loss.

definitionEn: To give particular emphasis or prominence to an idea, finding, or argument.
meaningVi: nhấn mạnh, làm nổi bật
existingExample: Public health experts repeatedly stress the importance of early screening in lowering cardiovascular mortality rates.

definitionEn: Coming after something else in time, sequence, or logical order.
meaningVi: tiếp theo, sau đó, kế tiếp
existingExample: Initial policy missteps were rectified through subsequent amendments enacted during the following parliamentary session.

definitionEn: A total amount resulting from the addition of numbers, or a specific quantity of money.
meaningVi: tổng số, khoản tiền
existingExample: Municipal authorities allocated a substantial sum toward retrofitting public libraries with solar rooftop panels.

definitionEn: A concise, structured overview presenting the principal points or findings of a longer work.
meaningVi: bản tóm tắt, sự tổng lược
existingExample: Every policy briefing begins with an executive summary so decision-makers can grasp the key recommendations immediately.

definitionEn: To commit oneself to and begin a substantial, demanding, or formal task, study, or responsibility.
meaningVi: đảm nhận, tiến hành, thực hiện
existingExample: Environmental agencies must undertake comprehensive impact assessments before approving offshore wind installations.

definitionEn: A society or institution of distinguished scholars, artists, or scientists dedicated to advancing a specific discipline.
meaningVi: học viện; viện hàn lâm
existingExample: The national academy publishes peer-reviewed monographs that shape contemporary environmental policy across Europe.

definitionEn: To change something slightly so that it fits properly or adapts to new conditions.
meaningVi: điều chỉnh; thích nghi
existingExample: Central banks routinely adjust benchmark interest rates to curb inflationary pressures without stifling economic growth.

definitionEn: To change in character, composition, or structure, typically in a comparatively small but significant way.
meaningVi: thay đổi, biến đổi
existingExample: Prolonged exposure to rising ocean temperatures can fundamentally alter the reproductive cycles of coastal marine species.

definitionEn: To make formal minor changes to a law, policy, or document to improve accuracy or fairness.
meaningVi: sửa đổi, bổ sung (luật, văn bản)
existingExample: Lawmakers voted overwhelmingly to amend the data protection statute in response to emerging artificial intelligence risks.

definitionEn: Having knowledge or perception of a situation, fact, or potential consequence.
meaningVi: nhận thức được, có ý thức về
existingExample: Consumers are becoming increasingly aware of the carbon footprint associated with fast-fashion supply chains.

definitionEn: The maximum amount that something can contain or produce, or the innate ability to do or understand something.
meaningVi: năng lực, sức chứa, công suất
existingExample: Expanding renewable grid capacity is essential if developing nations intend to meet their decarbonisation commitments.

definitionEn: A demanding task or complex situation that tests someone's abilities, resources, or determination.
meaningVi: thách thức, thử thách
existingExample: Ensuring equitable access to affordable healthcare remains a formidable challenge for rapidly ageing societies.

definitionEn: A particular and separate article, stipulation, or proviso in a treaty, bill, or legal contract.
meaningVi: điều khoản (trong hợp đồng, luật); mệnh đề
existingExample: The trade agreement incorporates a safeguard clause allowing member states to impose temporary tariffs during market shocks.

definitionEn: A substance or entity formed from two or more separate elements chemically or structurally combined.
meaningVi: hợp chất; tổ hợp
existingExample: Biochemists isolated a novel organic compound from deep-sea bacteria that demonstrates remarkable antimicrobial properties.

definitionEn: A serious disagreement, incompatibility, or prolonged armed struggle between opposing groups, principles, or interests.
meaningVi: xung đột, mâu thuẫn
existingExample: Urban planners frequently encounter a sharp conflict between preserving historic architecture and constructing high-density housing.

definitionEn: To seek professional advice, information, or formal input from an expert, stakeholder, or reference source.
meaningVi: tham khảo ý kiến, tư vấn
existingExample: Municipal authorities must consult local indigenous communities before approving large-scale hydroelectric infrastructure projects.

definitionEn: The state or condition of physical touching, social interaction, or ongoing communication between individuals or groups.
meaningVi: sự tiếp xúc, liên hệ
existingExample: Regular face-to-face contact with mentors significantly improves retention rates among first-generation university students.

definitionEn: A gradual and continuous loss of strength, numbers, quality, or economic value over time.
meaningVi: sự suy giảm, sự suy thoái
existingExample: Longitudinal surveys reveal a steady decline in pollinator populations across intensively farmed regions of Western Europe.

definitionEn: Individually separate and distinct, rather than continuous or merged together.
meaningVi: riêng biệt, rời rạc
existingExample: The curriculum divides advanced statistical modelling into six discrete modules to ensure progressive mastery of each concept.

definitionEn: A preliminary version of a written work, legislative bill, or policy proposal subject to further revision.
meaningVi: bản thảo, dự thảo
existingExample: Committee delegates spent three days scrutinising the initial draft of the climate accord before submitting formal amendments.

definitionEn: To give someone or something the authority, capacity, or means to accomplish a particular action.
meaningVi: cho phép, tạo điều kiện cho
existingExample: High-speed satellite broadband will enable rural clinics to access specialist diagnostic consultations in real time.

definitionEn: Power derived from physical or chemical resources, especially to provide light and heat or to operate machinery.
meaningVi: năng lượng
existingExample: Transitioning from fossil fuels to geothermal energy requires sustained public investment in transmission infrastructure.

definitionEn: To compel strict observance of or compliance with a law, regulation, or institutional obligation.
meaningVi: thực thi, thi hành (luật, quy định)
existingExample: Without adequately funded regulatory agencies, governments struggle to enforce strict emissions standards on heavy industry.

definitionEn: A thing, organisation, or legal body with a distinct and independent existence.
meaningVi: thực thể, đơn vị độc lập
existingExample: Under international maritime law, the newly established port authority operates as an autonomous legal entity.

definitionEn: Equal in value, amount, function, meaning, or measurable effect to something else.
meaningVi: tương đương
existingExample: The annual carbon savings achieved by the metro expansion are equivalent to removing forty thousand private vehicles from circulation.

definitionEn: To develop gradually over time, especially from a simple form to a more complex or better-adapted one.
meaningVi: tiến hóa, phát triển dần
existingExample: Higher education institutions must evolve rapidly to prepare graduates for labour markets reshaped by automation.

definitionEn: To become or make larger, more extensive, or broader in scope, volume, or operational reach.
meaningVi: mở rộng, gia tăng
existingExample: Several biotechnology firms plan to expand their clinical research facilities across Southeast Asia over the next decade.

definitionEn: To make something visible by uncovering it, or to leave someone or something vulnerable to a risk or influence.
meaningVi: phơi bày; khiến chịu tác động của
existingExample: Investigative audits frequently expose systemic weaknesses in municipal procurement procedures that allow corruption to flourish.

definitionEn: To make an action, process, or outcome easier or more achievable to carry out.
meaningVi: tạo điều kiện thuận lợi, thúc đẩy
existingExample: Standardised digital customs platforms significantly facilitate cross-border commerce for small and medium-sized enterprises.

definitionEn: Forming a necessary base or core of central importance upon which other structures or principles depend.
meaningVi: cơ bản, nền tảng, cốt lõi
existingExample: Transparent judicial oversight is a fundamental prerequisite for sustaining investor confidence in emerging markets.

definitionEn: To produce, cause to arise, or bring into existence, especially energy, revenue, data, or ideas.
meaningVi: tạo ra, phát sinh
existingExample: Offshore wind turbines installed along the North Sea coast generate sufficient electricity to supply millions of households.

definitionEn: All people born around the same era, or the process of producing energy such as electricity.
meaningVi: thế hệ; sự tạo ra (điện, năng lượng)
existingExample: Each successive generation of urban residents has placed greater emphasis on walkable neighbourhoods and accessible green space.

definitionEn: A visual representation of something, or the general public impression of a person or institution.
meaningVi: hình ảnh; hình tượng công chúng
existingExample: Multinational corporations invest heavily in sustainability campaigns to cultivate an environmentally responsible public image.

definitionEn: Willing to respect or accept differing opinions, favouring individual liberty and social reform, or provided in generous amounts.
meaningVi: tự do, cởi mở; hào phóng
existingExample: Advocates of liberal trade policies contend that lowering import tariffs fosters innovation and reduces consumer prices.

definitionEn: Reasoning conducted or assessed according to strict principles of validity, coherence, and sound inference.
meaningVi: luận lý, tính hợp lý
existingExample: Critics questioned the underlying economic logic of subsidising coal-fired power stations while pledging net-zero emissions.

definitionEn: The difference between two amounts, a narrow edge, or the profit gap between cost and price.
meaningVi: biên độ, phần chênh lệch; lề
existingExample: Tightening global supply chains compressed the profit margin of independent agricultural exporters throughout the fiscal year.

definitionEn: Relating to the science or practice of diagnosing, treating, and preventing illness and injury.
meaningVi: thuộc y học, y tế
existingExample: Recent breakthroughs in genomic sequencing have transformed medical diagnostics for rare hereditary disorders.

definitionEn: Relating to the mind, cognitive processes, or emotional and psychological well-being.
meaningVi: thuộc tinh thần, trí tuệ, tâm lý
existingExample: Workplace wellbeing initiatives increasingly recognise that chronic stress has a measurable impact on employee mental health.

definitionEn: To make partial or targeted changes to something, typically to improve its suitability, efficiency, or performance.
meaningVi: điều chỉnh, cải biến, sửa đổi
existingExample: Agricultural scientists continue to modify drought-resistant cereal crops so farmers can sustain yields in arid climates.

definitionEn: To observe, measure, and check the progress, condition, or quality of something systematically over a period of time.
meaningVi: giám sát, theo dõi liên tục
existingExample: Environmental satellites continuously monitor glacial retreat across Antarctica to refine global sea-level projections.

definitionEn: An interconnected group or system of people, institutions, routes, or electronic devices sharing resources or information.
meaningVi: mạng lưới, hệ thống kết nối
existingExample: An integrated high-speed rail network substantially reduces regional dependence on short-haul commercial aviation.

definitionEn: A conception, belief, or general understanding of a principle, idea, or phenomenon.
meaningVi: khái niệm, quan niệm
existingExample: Contemporary economists largely challenge the traditional notion that perpetual material growth guarantees societal happiness.

definitionEn: A clearly defined goal, target, or outcome that a person, policy, or organisation seeks to achieve.
meaningVi: mục tiêu cụ thể
existingExample: The primary objective of the urban renewal programme is to revitalise derelict industrial districts without displacing residents.

definitionEn: To align, position, or direct something or someone towards a specific goal, audience, or point of reference.
meaningVi: định hướng, hướng tới
existingExample: Universities are redesigning undergraduate engineering degrees to orient students towards sustainable design principles early on.

definitionEn: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding and interpreting an issue, event, or body of evidence.
meaningVi: góc nhìn, quan điểm
existingExample: Examining urbanisation from a historical perspective clarifies why coastal metropolises remain hubs of global commerce.

definitionEn: Of foremost importance, highest quality, or representing the most typical and illustrative example.
meaningVi: chủ yếu, hàng đầu, trọng yếu
existingExample: Singapore serves as a prime example of how meticulous land-use planning can reconcile dense population growth with liveability.

definitionEn: The scientific study of the human mind, cognitive processes, and behavioural patterns in individuals and groups.
meaningVi: tâm lý học
existingExample: Insights from behavioural psychology have helped public agencies design retirement savings schemes with higher voluntary enrolment.

definitionEn: To follow or engage in an activity, policy, or long-term ambition with sustained effort in order to attain it.
meaningVi: theo đuổi, tiến hành
existingExample: Graduates with interdisciplinary analytical skills are better positioned to pursue careers in emerging green-technology sectors.

definitionEn: The quantitative relation between two amounts showing the number of times one value contains or is contained within the other.
meaningVi: tỷ lệ, tỷ số
existingExample: Reducing the student-to-teacher ratio in primary schools has been consistently linked to stronger early literacy outcomes.

definitionEn: To dismiss a proposal, argument, or hypothesis as inadequate, unacceptable, or unsupported by evidence.
meaningVi: bác bỏ, từ chối
existingExample: Independent peer reviewers decided to reject the manuscript because its sample size was too small to support general conclusions.

definitionEn: Income generated regularly by an organisation from its operations or collected by a government through taxation.
meaningVi: doanh thu; nguồn thu ngân sách
existingExample: Municipal councils increasingly rely on congestion charges to generate dedicated revenue for modernising public bus fleets.

definitionEn: Not likely to change, fluctuate unpredictably, or fail; firmly established and balanced.
meaningVi: ổn định, vững chắc
existingExample: Long-term infrastructure investors prioritise jurisdictions that maintain a stable macroeconomic and regulatory environment.

definitionEn: A distinctive manner of doing, designing, writing, or expressing something characteristic of a particular period or group.
meaningVi: phong cách, kiểu cách
existingExample: Academic journals expect contributors to adopt an objective, concise writing style free from colloquial expressions.

definitionEn: To use or add a person or thing in place of another that previously fulfilled the same role.
meaningVi: thay thế
existingExample: Food manufacturers frequently substitute plant-based proteins for animal ingredients to appeal to environmentally conscious buyers.

definitionEn: To strengthen, support, or keep an activity, system, or level of performance going continuously over an extended period.
meaningVi: duy trì, chống đỡ; chịu đựng
existingExample: Without continuous technological innovation, mature industrial economies struggle to sustain high rates of productivity growth.

definitionEn: A mark, character, or object regarded as representing or standing for an abstract idea, quality, or institutional value.
meaningVi: biểu tượng, ký hiệu
existingExample: In many post-industrial cities, restored waterfront warehouses have become a prominent symbol of cultural regeneration.

definitionEn: A measurable objective, benchmark, or specific audience selected as the focus of a plan or policy.
meaningVi: mục tiêu, chỉ tiêu; đối tượng nhắm tới
existingExample: Although several European states have pledged ambitious emissions reductions, few are on track to meet their 2030 target.

definitionEn: The carrying of people or goods from one place to another, or an organised public transportation system.
meaningVi: sự vận chuyển, sự quá cảnh; giao thông công cộng
existingExample: Expanding rapid mass transit corridors is among the most cost-effective strategies for alleviating metropolitan traffic congestion.

definitionEn: A general direction in which a phenomenon, statistical metric, or social behaviour is developing or changing over time.
meaningVi: xu hướng, khuynh hướng
existingExample: Demographic records point to an unmistakable upward trend in the proportion of single-person households in East Asia.

definitionEn: A particular form or edition of something that differs in certain respects from an earlier or alternative form.
meaningVi: phiên bản, bản biến thể
existingExample: The revised version of the clinical protocol incorporates stricter safeguards for handling anonymised patient datasets.

definitionEn: The health, prosperity, and general well-being of a population, or financial and social support provided by the state.
meaningVi: phúc lợi, sự an sinh
existingExample: Comprehensive social welfare programmes play a vital role in cushioning low-income households against sudden economic downturns.
